title: Pickle Jar Days
style: indie folk, warm chamber pop, 92 BPM, female lead vocal, soft piano, steel-string fingerpicking, crowd hum, tape saturation, hopeful-grounded, nostalgic, bittersweet chorus
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
We were young and badly planned
Kept the summer in a can
Lid sealed tight with too much hope
Forgot that summers couldn't cope

[Verse 2]
Middle of the worst December
Found the jar — do you remember?
Cracked it open, hit us hard
Smelled like everything we are

[Chorus]
Pickle jar days, pickle jar days
Preserved in brine and better ways
Pickle jar days, strange and bright
We were right to keep them tight
